ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Work Control (0.3.0-alpha.12). Bug-fix iteration. The horizontal lane scrollbar is now fixed above the matrix (outside the rows), thicker and reliably draggable/clickable, so many-row lists keep a working horizontal scroll; wheel works over names or lanes, names move only vertically, auto-hide remains. The search row restores a visible Work text filter beside the WorkType selector, removes the Work prefix from the selector, uses a Not inversion button, and shows an N match(es) / No pawns match count. Drag targets now follow the actual hover: an unselected hovered row receives the drop alone; the selected group is updated only when 2+ rows are selected and the drop is inside that group. Palette tooltips no longer derive a skill from the selected pawn: they list relevant skill names plus all global WorkGivers, and a safe skill lookup avoids missing-skill fallback log spam. Lane tooltips split Skill, Passion, Level and Rank (plus description/all WorkGivers and the pawn override hook), and vanilla passion icon colors are preserved. Cards are ~14 px tighter and the ghost uses the new width. Colonist-bar order, resurrection reapply, simple/manual Work-tab fixes, return button, right-click max, selection, Recommend/Details, colors, auto-recommend and save/load are kept. No profiles, schedules, equipment or multi-pawn. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
